extracted.name: Caramel Popcorn with Marshmallow
extracted.description: This marshmallow caramel popcorn recipe combines three classic treats into one sweet treat using only six ingredients you likely have in your pantry.
ingredient_lines: 0.25 cup light corn syrup (such as Karo®)
instruction_lines: Stir marshmallows, brown sugar, butter, corn syrup, and vanilla extract together in a large pot over medium-low heat until marshmallows melt, 5 to 7 minutes.
Place popcorn in a large bowl; pour marshmallow mixture over popcorn and gently stir to coat.
